package.name: nidar_slam
package.description: FAST-LIO glue for NIDAR: the mapping launch, the FAST-LIO parameter file it loads (config/fast_lio/nidar_sim.yaml, whose altitude datum and extrinsics are rendered by nidar_config/scripts/apply_mission_config.py), the robot_description URDF and the RViz profile. Publishes /Fast_LIO/odometry and /cloud_registered.
